parsed.summary: Comparing the netlist to the design specification shows the board is functionally as intended: the TPS2121 power mux (IN1=+12V, IN2=+5V, OUT=VBUS, ILIM set by a 51.1k resistor, SS with 10nF), the AP63203 buck (SW -> 3.9uH -> +3V3 with bootstrap cap and FB tied to +3V3), the TPS1H200 smart high-side switch (VS=+12V, OUT to the heater terminal, IN/DIAG_EN driven by GPIO1, CL=GND, ~FAULT to a test point only), three MAX31855 thermocouple front-ends on a shared SPI (GPIO5/GPIO10) with independent chip selects on GPIO4/6/7, two fan-tach inputs with TVS protection and pull-ups, USB-C CC 5.1k pulldowns, and the WS2812B status LED on +3V3. All specified values and interfaces match, so no deviation that would change the board's behaviour was found.
